evidence.text: Implemented work.py evaluate: validates missing required request conditions; filters claim, withdrawal, verification, and required-condition equality; applies eligible-record supersedes; compares canonical JSON; returns unknown/conflict/supported/unsupported without mutating inputs. Generated report.json from current fixtures. Local fixture, immutability, missing-condition, supersession, verification, canonical-object agreement, and conflict checks passed.

Unresolved limit: supersedes is interpreted as either a scalar source ID or a collection under the 'supersedes' key; the task does not define alternative supersession field shapes. JSON values containing NaN/Infinity are rejected because they are not valid canonical JSON.

Milestone complete: implemented and verified evaluate(request, evidence, policy) in work.py and generated report.json for current fixtures. Checks passed for compilation, fixture/report equality, input immutability, sorted missing conditions, no-evidence unknown, verified filtering, withdrawal/condition/claim filtering, eligible supersession, canonical object agreement, Boolean-false unsupported, and disagreement conflict. Unresolved limits remain: supersedes is assumed to be the 'supersedes' scalar-or-collection field; non-finite floats are rejected as invalid canonical JSON.

Stage 2 work sample 0 complete. work.py evaluate filters by claim, withdrawal, exact canonical JSON matches for required conditions, and optional verified status; reports sorted missing conditions, applies supersession only among eligible records, detects canonical JSON agreement/conflict, preserves Boolean false as unsupported, deep-copies returned values, and does not mutate inputs. report.json was regenerated: vertical_rate=32 from S2 (which supersedes S1), device_validated=false from D1. Local assertions cover filtering, canonical object comparisons, supersession, conflicts, missing/no evidence, false, input immutability, and report consistency.

Unresolved limit: canonical JSON comparison intentionally requires JSON-serializable values and rejects NaN/Infinity via allow_nan=False, consistent with the task's canonical JSON wording. Evidence source IDs are assumed present and sortable, as required output calls for sorted source IDs.

Stage 3 work sample 0 complete. work.py evaluate filters evidence by matching claim, non-withdrawn status, policy-required condition values using canonical JSON, and verification when required; reports sorted missing conditions, applies eligible-record supersession, detects canonical-value conflict without source-count authority, maps Boolean false to unsupported, deep-copies agreed values, and does not modify inputs. report.json matches evaluation of current requests.json against evidence.json and policy.json. Local checks passed 8 behavioral cases plus report regeneration equivalence.

Unresolved limit: inputs and compared values are expected to be JSON-compatible. Canonical comparison uses json.dumps(..., allow_nan=False), so non-JSON values and NaN/Infinity raise rather than being assigned special semantics. Supersedes accepts a scalar or collection and operates by source ID among otherwise eligible records; duplicate source IDs are preserved in output because the task only requires sorted IDs, not deduplication.

Stage 3 source_comparison work sample 0 is complete and verified. work.py implements required filtering, exact required-condition matching via canonical JSON, verified-only policy, eligible-source supersession, no-evidence and disagreement outcomes, Boolean-false unsupported status, sorted source/unknown lists, and input preservation. report.json equals evaluation of all current requests against current evidence and policy. Eight focused behavioral checks and report equivalence passed. Remaining documented limit: inputs are expected to be JSON-compatible; non-JSON values and NaN/Infinity are not assigned custom semantics.
